subject: lotus-shell snail
pose: 三分之二侧面，头部抬高
art_direction: 蜗牛壳像半开莲蓬灯，奶白花瓣露出青绿种格，粉陶身体略仰头。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Create a snail-shaped ceramic character whose shell opens into a compact lotus cup. Cream petals surround a celadon seedpod center with several large recessed cells, but nothing glows from within. The body is dusty-pink earthenware, with a broad rounded head and two short antennae tilted toward the viewer. It lifts the front of its body in a quiet expectant pose. Use a dark slate-teal background, subtle glaze pooling, and matte clay at the base. Avoid wet slime, realistic shell spirals, aquatic scenery, or many decorative blossoms. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
